text: I work in an online school. I talk to new students and tell them about our courses. The job is busy, but I like it because I meet many different people.

tips.en: A concrete detail makes the answer vivid and convincing instead of generic (Lexical Resource).

text: I start at ten o'clock in the morning. It is not too early, so I can have breakfast at home. I prefer this time because I am not a morning person.

tips.en: This phrase links the answer to a reason or extension, which keeps the answer coherent (Fluency and Coherence).

tips.ru: Фраза помогает связно объяснить ответ: после прямого ответа сразу идёт причина или продолжение мысли.

questions.question: Is it important for you to have a good salary?

text: Maybe, in a few years. I would like to find a job with more free time and travel. At the moment I am happy, but it is good to have plans.
